description:
The animated short film "Four Seasons", aims to express the emotions and feelings related to "summer-autumn-winter-spring", and is drawn frame by frame using traditional oil painting glass panels to produce visual effects and charm not found in computer animation.

(Source: Shanghai Animation Film Studio Weibo, translated)
